dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了自然界的變化規律，包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化するパターン、気候や季節の移り変わり、天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運行劃分為24個節氣，用以指導古代中國的農業活動。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを24の節気に分け、古代中国の農業を管理するために使いました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億の中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: Around the 8th of September each year, the Chinese people welcomed the 15th solar term, White Dew.
dialogue.zh: 每年九月初八左右，中國人迎來第十五個節氣——白露。
dialogue.ja: 毎年9月8日頃、中国の人々は15番目の節気「白露」を迎えます。
dialogue.local: Around the 8th of September each year, the Chinese people welcomed the 15th solar term, White Dew.
dialogue.en: Around the 8th of September each year, the Chinese people welcomed the 15th solar term, White Dew.

dialogue.text: Temperatures begin to cool and migratory birds set off on their south-bound journeys.
dialogue.zh: 氣溫開始轉涼，候鳥啟程南遷。
dialogue.ja: 気温が冷え始め、渡り鳥たちは南へ向けて旅立ちます。
dialogue.local: Temperatures begin to cool and migratory birds set off on their south-bound journeys.
dialogue.en: Temperatures begin to cool and migratory birds set off on their south-bound journeys.

dialogue.text: It's time for savoring the autumn scenery, and for those far from their families, reminiscing memories of home.
dialogue.zh: 這是欣賞秋天景色的時節，對於遠離家鄉的人們，也是思念家的時刻。
dialogue.ja: 秋の景色を楽しむ時期であり、家族から離れている人々にとっては故郷を懐かしむ時間でもあります。
dialogue.local: It's time for savoring the autumn scenery, and for those far from their families, reminiscing memories of home.
dialogue.en: It's time for savoring the autumn scenery, and for those far from their families, reminiscing memories of home.

dialogue.text: As mid-autumn approaches, the weather turns cool.
dialogue.zh: 隨著中秋節的臨近，天氣變得涼爽。
dialogue.ja: 中秋が近づくにつれて、天気は涼しくなります。
dialogue.local: As mid-autumn approaches, the weather turns cool.
dialogue.en: As mid-autumn approaches, the weather turns cool.

dialogue.text: At the early hours of dawn, if you look closely enough, you can see dew drops on foliage start to crystallize.
dialogue.zh: 黎明時分，如果仔細觀察，可以看到葉子上的露珠開始結晶。
dialogue.ja: 夜明けの早朝、よく見ると葉の露が結晶し始めているのが見えます。
dialogue.local: At the early hours of dawn, if you look closely enough, you can see dew drops on foliage start to crystallize.
dialogue.en: At the early hours of dawn, if you look closely enough, you can see dew drops on foliage start to crystallize.

dialogue.text: This is the 15th term of the 24 solar terms. The Chinese people have named it White Dew.
dialogue.zh: 這是24節氣中的第十五個節氣，中國人稱之為白露。
dialogue.ja: これは24節気の15番目の節気で、中国の人々はこれを「白露」と呼んでいます。
dialogue.local: This is the 15th term of the 24 solar terms. The Chinese people have named it White Dew.
dialogue.en: This is the 15th term of the 24 solar terms. The Chinese people have named it White Dew.

dialogue.text: Guangxi Guilin, located in southern China with its remarkable karst landforms, is home to several Chinese ethnic minorities.
dialogue.zh: 廣西桂林位於中國南方，以其獨特的喀斯特地貌聞名，是多個中國少數民族的家園。
dialogue.ja: 中国南部に位置する広西桂林は、独特なカルスト地形で知られ、いくつかの中国の少数民族が住んでいます。
dialogue.local: Guangxi Guilin, located in southern China with its remarkable karst landforms, is home to several Chinese ethnic minorities.
dialogue.en: Guangxi Guilin, located in southern China with its remarkable karst landforms, is home to several Chinese ethnic minorities.

dialogue.text: This peculiar natural environment, combined with a diverse array of cultures, has made everything about this place seem extraordinary.
dialogue.zh: 這種特殊的自然環境，加上多元的文化，使這個地方的一切都顯得非凡。
dialogue.ja: この特異な自然環境と多様な文化が組み合わさり、この場所のすべてが特別に見えます。
dialogue.local: This peculiar natural environment, combined with a diverse array of cultures, has made everything about this place seem extraordinary.
dialogue.en: This peculiar natural environment, combined with a diverse array of cultures, has made everything about this place seem extraordinary.

dialogue.text: The days leading up to White Dew are known as the Ghost Festival, and a grand ceremony is about to commence.
dialogue.zh: 白露節氣前的幾天被稱為中元節，盛大的儀式即將開始。
dialogue.ja: 白露の前の日々は「お盆」として知られ、盛大な儀式が始まろうとしています。
dialogue.local: The days leading up to White Dew are known as the Ghost Festival, and a grand ceremony is about to commence.
dialogue.en: The days leading up to White Dew are known as the Ghost Festival, and a grand ceremony is about to commence.

dialogue.text: In societies, whole family, relatives and ancestors close at heart.
dialogue.zh: 在社會中，整個家庭、親戚和祖先都被緊緊銘記於心。
dialogue.ja: 社会では、家族全員や親戚、先祖が心に深く刻まれています。
dialogue.local: In societies, whole family, relatives and ancestors close at heart.
dialogue.en: In societies, whole family, relatives and ancestors close at heart.

dialogue.text: In many places around the globe, people believe that those who have left this world continue to live on in another.
dialogue.zh: 世界許多地方的人們相信，離開這個世界的人們會在另一個世界繼續存在。
dialogue.ja: 世界の多くの場所で、人々はこの世を去った者たちが別の世界で生き続けていると信じています。
dialogue.local: In many places around the globe, people believe that those who have left this world continue to live on in another.
dialogue.en: In many places around the globe, people believe that those who have left this world continue to live on in another.

dialogue.text: Every year, during the Ghost Festival, the people of Guilin perform a floating river lantern ceremony, in which the deceased are remembered whilst the living are blessed.
dialogue.zh: 每年中元節期間，桂林人會舉行放河燈儀式，既紀念逝者，也祈福生者。
dialogue.ja: 毎年お盆の期間中、桂林の人々は川に灯籠を流す儀式を行い、亡くなった人々を偲び、生きている人々に祝福を祈ります。
dialogue.local: Every year, during the Ghost Festival, the people of Guilin perform a floating river lantern ceremony, in which the deceased are remembered whilst the living are blessed.
dialogue.en: Every year, during the Ghost Festival, the people of Guilin perform a floating river lantern ceremony, in which the deceased are remembered whilst the living are blessed.

dialogue.text: Every year, during White Dew, he receives a new identity.
dialogue.zh: 每年白露節氣期間，他獲得新的身份。
dialogue.ja: 毎年白露の時期に、彼は新たな身分を得ます。
dialogue.local: Every year, during White Dew, he receives a new identity.
dialogue.en: Every year, during White Dew, he receives a new identity.

dialogue.text: River Lantern Craftsman: His family have been making river lanterns for over 160 years.
dialogue.zh: 河燈工匠：他的家族已經製作河燈超過160年。
dialogue.ja: 川灯籠職人：彼の家族は160年以上にわたり川灯籠を作り続けています。
dialogue.local: River Lantern Craftsman: His family have been making river lanterns for over 160 years.
dialogue.en: River Lantern Craftsman: His family have been making river lanterns for over 160 years.

dialogue.text: These river lanterns are the highlights of the Ghost Festival ritual.
dialogue.zh: 這些河燈是中元節儀式的重點。
dialogue.ja: これらの川灯籠はお盆の儀式のハイライトです。
dialogue.local: These river lanterns are the highlights of the Ghost Festival ritual.
dialogue.en: These river lanterns are the highlights of the Ghost Festival ritual.

dialogue.text: Not far from the river banks, over a paddy field, lies following friends' makeshift workshop.
dialogue.zh: 在河岸不遠處的稻田上，有朋友們臨時搭建的工作坊。
dialogue.ja: 川岸から遠くない水田の上に、友人たちの仮設工房があります。
dialogue.local: Not far from the river banks, over a paddy field, lies following friends' makeshift workshop.
dialogue.en: Not far from the river banks, over a paddy field, lies following friends' makeshift workshop.

dialogue.text: Truth be told, these river lanterns are not particularly elegant, but yet they have soul and they are truly beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，這些河燈並不特別優雅，但它們有靈魂，真的很美。
dialogue.ja: 正直に言うと、これらの川灯籠は特に優雅ではありませんが、魂があり、本当に美しいです。
dialogue.local: Truth be told, these river lanterns are not particularly elegant, but yet they have soul and they are truly beautiful.
dialogue.en: Truth be told, these river lanterns are not particularly elegant, but yet they have soul and they are truly beautiful.

dialogue.text: From bamboo designs to paper pasting and colouring, every step requires meticulous handling.
dialogue.zh: 從竹子設計到貼紙和上色，每一步都需要細心處理。
dialogue.ja: 竹のデザインから紙の貼り付けや彩色まで、すべての工程が細心の注意を要します。
dialogue.local: From bamboo designs to paper pasting and colouring, every step requires meticulous handling.
dialogue.en: From bamboo designs to paper pasting and colouring, every step requires meticulous handling.

dialogue.text: The slightest mistake could easily turn a tiger into a kitten.
dialogue.zh: 稍有差錯就可能讓老虎變成小貓。
dialogue.ja: わずかなミスで虎が子猫になってしまうこともあります。
dialogue.local: The slightest mistake could easily turn a tiger into a kitten.
dialogue.en: The slightest mistake could easily turn a tiger into a kitten.

dialogue.text: Using the White Dew slack farming season every year, this handicraft work has given fun when shown an extra portion of income.
dialogue.zh: 利用白露節氣的農閒季節，每年從事這項手工藝工作既有樂趣，也帶來額外收入。
dialogue.ja: 毎年白露の農閑期を利用して、この手工芸は楽しみを与え、追加の収入ももたらしています。
dialogue.local: Using the White Dew slack farming season every year, this handicraft work has given fun when shown an extra portion of income.
dialogue.en: Using the White Dew slack farming season every year, this handicraft work has given fun when shown an extra portion of income.

dialogue.text: Night falls and the Ghost Festival ceremony begins.
dialogue.zh: 夜幕降臨，中元節儀式開始。
dialogue.ja: 夜が訪れ、お盆の儀式が始まります。
dialogue.local: Night falls and the Ghost Festival ceremony begins.
dialogue.en: Night falls and the Ghost Festival ceremony begins.

dialogue.text: The glowing lanterns set carefully onto the water, sail downstream.
dialogue.zh: 發光的燈籠被小心地放入水中，順流漂去。
dialogue.ja: 光る灯籠が慎重に水に置かれ、川下へと流れていきます。
dialogue.local: The glowing lanterns set carefully onto the water, sail downstream.
dialogue.en: The glowing lanterns set carefully onto the water, sail downstream.

dialogue.text: The hopes of a lasting river current carry the prayers and memories of loved ones far and beyond, such a scene has repeated itself for thousands of years.
dialogue.zh: 持續的河流承載著祈禱與對親人的思念，這樣的場景已重複了數千年。
dialogue.ja: 永続する川の流れが愛する人々への祈りと記憶を遠くへ運び、この光景は何千年も繰り返されています。
dialogue.local: The hopes of a lasting river current carry the prayers and memories of loved ones far and beyond, such a scene has repeated itself for thousands of years.
dialogue.en: The hopes of a lasting river current carry the prayers and memories of loved ones far and beyond, such a scene has repeated itself for thousands of years.

dialogue.text: Entrusted with hopes and promises, the lanterns float onwards, and as they depart from our sights, the harvest season or crop specades, marking the beginning of the busy farming season.
dialogue.zh: 承載著希望與承諾，燈籠繼續漂流，當它們離開視線時，收穫季節結束，忙碌的農耕季節開始了。
dialogue.ja: 希望と約束を託され、灯籠は漂い続け、視界から消えると収穫期が終わり、忙しい農作業の季節が始まります。
dialogue.local: Entrusted with hopes and promises, the lanterns float onwards, and as they depart from our sights, the harvest season or crop specades, marking the beginning of the busy farming season.
dialogue.en: Entrusted with hopes and promises, the lanterns float onwards, and as they depart from our sights, the harvest season or crop specades, marking the beginning of the busy farming season.

dialogue.text: Some holidays are also reaching their end.
dialogue.zh: 一些假期也接近尾聲。
dialogue.ja: いくつかの休日も終わりに近づいています。
dialogue.local: Some holidays are also reaching their end.
dialogue.en: Some holidays are also reaching their end.

dialogue.text: Young people gather their baggage and leave home, some to study, others for work.
dialogue.zh: 年輕人收拾行李離家，有的去求學，有的去工作。
dialogue.ja: 若者たちは荷物をまとめて家を出ます。勉強に行く人もいれば、仕事に行く人もいます。
dialogue.local: Young people gather their baggage and leave home, some to study, others for work.
dialogue.en: Young people gather their baggage and leave home, some to study, others for work.

dialogue.text: After coming to Guilin, I learnt of a Chinese saying, the mountains and waters of Guilin are the finest of all.
dialogue.zh: 來到桂林後，我了解到一句中國諺語：桂林山水甲天下。
dialogue.ja: 桂林に来て、中国のことわざ「桂林の山水は天下一」を知りました。
dialogue.local: After coming to Guilin, I learnt of a Chinese saying, the mountains and waters of Guilin are the finest of all.
dialogue.en: After coming to Guilin, I learnt of a Chinese saying, the mountains and waters of Guilin are the finest of all.

dialogue.text: The mountains refer to these jagged lava forms.
dialogue.zh: 山指的是這些崎嶇的喀斯特地貌。
dialogue.ja: 山はこれらのギザギザした溶岩地形を指します。
dialogue.local: The mountains refer to these jagged lava forms.
dialogue.en: The mountains refer to these jagged lava forms.

dialogue.text: The waters point to the Li Zhang river, which locals call the Mother River.
dialogue.zh: 水指的是漓江，當地人稱之為母親河。
dialogue.ja: 水は地元の人々が母なる川と呼ぶ漓江を指します。
dialogue.local: The waters point to the Li Zhang river, which locals call the Mother River.
dialogue.en: The waters point to the Li Zhang river, which locals call the Mother River.

dialogue.text: Thousands of years ago, the people here began training cormorant birds to fish for a living.
dialogue.zh: 數千年前，這裡的人們開始訓練鸕鶿捕魚為生。
dialogue.ja: 何千年も前、ここに住む人々はウミウを訓練して漁を生業とし始めました。
dialogue.local: Thousands of years ago, the people here began training cormorant birds to fish for a living.
dialogue.en: Thousands of years ago, the people here began training cormorant birds to fish for a living.

dialogue.text: A bamboo raft sits on a magnificent river, human and bird working together, living by fishing.
dialogue.zh: 一隻竹筏漂浮在壯麗的河流上，人與鳥合作，以捕魚為生。
dialogue.ja: 竹のいかだが壮大な川に浮かび、人と鳥が協力して漁をしながら生活しています。
dialogue.local: A bamboo raft sits on a magnificent river, human and bird working together, living by fishing.
dialogue.en: A bamboo raft sits on a magnificent river, human and bird working together, living by fishing.

dialogue.text: The White Dew solar term each year happens to be when newborn cormorant chicks are growing, and is also when river fish fattened for winter hibernation, the perfect season for fishing as a rider.
dialogue.zh: 每年白露節氣正值鸕鶿幼鳥成長期，也是河魚為冬眠儲備脂肪的時候，是捕魚的最佳季節。
dialogue.ja: 毎年の白露の節気は、ウミウのひな鳥が成長する時期であり、川の魚が冬眠のために脂肪を蓄える時期でもあり、漁に最適な季節です。
dialogue.local: The White Dew solar term each year happens to be when newborn cormorant chicks are growing, and is also when river fish fattened for winter hibernation, the perfect season for fishing as a rider.
dialogue.en: The White Dew solar term each year happens to be when newborn cormorant chicks are growing, and is also when river fish fattened for winter hibernation, the perfect season for fishing as a rider.

dialogue.text: To be honest, manipulating birds to catch fish can seem cruel.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，利用鳥兒捕魚看起來可能有些殘忍。
dialogue.ja: 正直に言うと、鳥を操って魚を捕るのは残酷に見えるかもしれません。
dialogue.local: To be honest, manipulating birds to catch fish can seem cruel.
dialogue.en: To be honest, manipulating birds to catch fish can seem cruel.

dialogue.text: Fishermen tie thin hemp string around the birds' neck to prevent them from swallowing fish.
dialogue.zh: 漁夫會在鳥的脖子上綁細麻繩，防止牠們吞下魚。
dialogue.ja: 漁師は鳥の首に細い麻ひもを結び、魚を飲み込まないようにします。
dialogue.local: Fishermen tie thin hemp string around the birds' neck to prevent them from swallowing fish.
dialogue.en: Fishermen tie thin hemp string around the birds' neck to prevent them from swallowing fish.

dialogue.text: He started fishing with his father at age 17.
dialogue.zh: 他17歲時開始和父親一起捕魚。
dialogue.ja: 彼は17歳の時に父親と一緒に漁を始めました。
dialogue.local: He started fishing with his father at age 17.
dialogue.en: He started fishing with his father at age 17.

dialogue.text: Today, he is the most well-known successor of the art of cormorant fishing.
dialogue.zh: 如今，他是最著名的鸕鶿捕魚技藝傳人。
dialogue.ja: 現在、彼はウミウ漁の技術の最も有名な継承者です。
dialogue.local: Today, he is the most well-known successor of the art of cormorant fishing.
dialogue.en: Today, he is the most well-known successor of the art of cormorant fishing.

dialogue.text: Most fishermen of Huang Tonggui's generation have spent their lives living on boats.
dialogue.zh: 黃同貴這一代的大多數漁夫一生都住在船上。
dialogue.ja: 黄同貴の世代のほとんどの漁師は、一生を船上で過ごしました。
dialogue.local: Most fishermen of Huang Tonggui's generation have spent their lives living on boats.
dialogue.en: Most fishermen of Huang Tonggui's generation have spent their lives living on boats.

dialogue.text: Their entire world is built upon what these birds can provide, and their eyes, cormorants are their closest companions.
dialogue.zh: 他們的整個世界建立在這些鳥能提供的資源上，鸕鶿是他們最親密的夥伴。
dialogue.ja: 彼らの世界はこれらの鳥がもたらすものに基づいており、ウミウは彼らの最も親しい仲間です。
dialogue.local: Their entire world is built upon what these birds can provide, and their eyes, cormorants are their closest companions.
dialogue.en: Their entire world is built upon what these birds can provide, and their eyes, cormorants are their closest companions.

dialogue.text: Yet in this ever-changing age the relationship between fishermen and cormorants are no longer that simple.
dialogue.zh: 然而在這個不斷變化的時代，漁夫與鸕鶿的關係已不再那麼簡單。
dialogue.ja: しかし、この変化の激しい時代において、漁師とウミウの関係はもはや単純ではありません。
dialogue.local: Yet in this ever-changing age the relationship between fishermen and cormorants are no longer that simple.
dialogue.en: Yet in this ever-changing age the relationship between fishermen and cormorants are no longer that simple.

dialogue.text: Due to the demands of tourist industry and under the local government's administration, fishermen like Huang Tonggui have long since moved out of their boats, and settled in the residential area by the river banks.
dialogue.zh: 由於旅遊業的需求和地方政府的管理，像黃同貴這樣的漁夫早已搬離船隻，定居在河岸邊的居民區。
dialogue.ja: 観光産業の需要と地方政府の管理により、黄同貴のような漁師は船を離れ、川岸の住宅地に定住しています。
dialogue.local: Due to the demands of tourist industry and under the local government's administration, fishermen like Huang Tonggui have long since moved out of their boats, and settled in the residential area by the river banks.
dialogue.en: Due to the demands of tourist industry and under the local government's administration, fishermen like Huang Tonggui have long since moved out of their boats, and settled in the residential area by the river banks.

dialogue.text: Here, they are still able to continue their fishing habits.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，他們仍能繼續捕魚的習慣。
dialogue.ja: ここでは、彼らはまだ漁を続けることができます。
dialogue.local: Here, they are still able to continue their fishing habits.
dialogue.en: Here, they are still able to continue their fishing habits.

dialogue.text: Guangdings Hai is Huang Tonggui's second cousin.
dialogue.zh: 廣定海是黃同貴的二表弟。
dialogue.ja: 広定海は黄同貴のいとこにあたります。
dialogue.local: Guangdings Hai is Huang Tonggui's second cousin.
dialogue.en: Guangdings Hai is Huang Tonggui's second cousin.

dialogue.text: From his mannerisms in attire, I feel that he is already worlds apart from the lifestyles of traditional fishermen.
dialogue.zh: 從他的舉止和穿著來看，我覺得他已經與傳統漁夫的生活方式大相逕庭。
dialogue.ja: 彼の態度や服装から、彼は伝統的な漁師の生活様式とはまったく異なる世界にいると感じます。
dialogue.local: From his mannerisms in attire, I feel that he is already worlds apart from the lifestyles of traditional fishermen.
dialogue.en: From his mannerisms in attire, I feel that he is already worlds apart from the lifestyles of traditional fishermen.

dialogue.text: Raising the cormorants is not an easy undertaking.
dialogue.zh: 飼養鸕鶿並非易事。
dialogue.ja: ウミウを育てることは簡単なことではありません。
dialogue.local: Raising the cormorants is not an easy undertaking.
dialogue.en: Raising the cormorants is not an easy undertaking.

dialogue.text: Other than feeding them, you have to train and care for them day after day.
dialogue.zh: 除了餵食，還要日復一日地訓練和照顧牠們。
dialogue.ja: 餌を与えるだけでなく、毎日訓練し世話をしなければなりません。
dialogue.local: Other than feeding them, you have to train and care for them day after day.
dialogue.en: Other than feeding them, you have to train and care for them day after day.

dialogue.text: I was surprised that Guangdings Hai had nine chicks.
dialogue.zh: 我很驚訝廣定海有九隻幼鳥。
dialogue.ja: 広定海が9羽のひな鳥を飼っているとは驚きました。
dialogue.local: I was surprised that Guangdings Hai had nine chicks.
dialogue.en: I was surprised that Guangdings Hai had nine chicks.

dialogue.text: I don't believe that his relationship with the birds is solely bound together by affection.
dialogue.zh: 我不認為他與鳥兒的關係僅僅是基於感情。
dialogue.ja: 彼と鳥との関係が単に愛情だけで結ばれているとは思いません。
dialogue.local: I don't believe that his relationship with the birds is solely bound together by affection.
dialogue.en: I don't believe that his relationship with the birds is solely bound together by affection.

dialogue.text: With its unique stunning landscapes and ancient fishing culture, Guilin has long since become one of China's most famous tourist attractions, and the locals no longer rely on cormorant fishing as a means of a living.
dialogue.zh: 憑藉獨特壯麗的風景和古老的漁文化，桂林早已成為中國最著名的旅遊景點之一，當地人也不再依賴鸕鶿捕魚為生。
dialogue.ja: 独特で美しい景観と古い漁文化を持つ桂林は、中国で最も有名な観光地の一つとなり、地元の人々はもはやウミウ漁に頼って生計を立てていません。
dialogue.local: With its unique stunning landscapes and ancient fishing culture, Guilin has long since become one of China's most famous tourist attractions, and the locals no longer rely on cormorant fishing as a means of a living.
dialogue.en: With its unique stunning landscapes and ancient fishing culture, Guilin has long since become one of China's most famous tourist attractions, and the locals no longer rely on cormorant fishing as a means of a living.

dialogue.text: Guangdings mountains and rivers as the stage.
dialogue.zh: 廣定海以山水為舞台。
dialogue.ja: 広定海は山と川を舞台にしています。
dialogue.local: Guangdings mountains and rivers as the stage.
dialogue.en: Guangdings mountains and rivers as the stage.

dialogue.text: The live show Song of Liu Sanjie, directed by China's famous film director, Zhang Yimou, is a major tourist attraction in Guangxi province.
dialogue.zh: 由中國著名導演張藝謀執導的現場演出《劉三姐之歌》，是廣西省的重要旅遊景點。
dialogue.ja: 中国の有名な映画監督、張芸謀が監督したライブショー「劉三姐の歌」は、広西省の主要な観光名所です。
dialogue.local: The live show Song of Liu Sanjie, directed by China's famous film director, Zhang Yimou, is a major tourist attraction in Guangxi province.
dialogue.en: The live show Song of Liu Sanjie, directed by China's famous film director, Zhang Yimou, is a major tourist attraction in Guangxi province.

dialogue.text: Within some 800 performers, over 200 are fishermen from the surrounding rural villages.
dialogue.zh: 約有800名表演者，其中超過200人是來自周邊農村的漁夫。
dialogue.ja: 約800人の出演者のうち、200人以上が周辺の農村から来た漁師です。
dialogue.local: Within some 800 performers, over 200 are fishermen from the surrounding rural villages.
dialogue.en: Within some 800 performers, over 200 are fishermen from the surrounding rural villages.

dialogue.text: It is said that the performances increase their annual income by at least 20 to 30,000 yuan; fishermen by day, actors by night.
dialogue.zh: 據說這些表演使他們的年收入增加了至少兩三萬元；白天是漁夫，晚上是演員。
dialogue.ja: この公演により、彼らの年収は少なくとも2万から3万元増えると言われています。昼は漁師、夜は俳優です。
dialogue.local: It is said that the performances increase their annual income by at least 20 to 30,000 yuan; fishermen by day, actors by night.
dialogue.en: It is said that the performances increase their annual income by at least 20 to 30,000 yuan; fishermen by day, actors by night.

dialogue.text: This has already become the lifestyle of the local fishermen.
dialogue.zh: 這已經成為當地漁夫的生活方式。
dialogue.ja: これはすでに地元の漁師の生活様式となっています。
dialogue.local: This has already become the lifestyle of the local fishermen.
dialogue.en: This has already become the lifestyle of the local fishermen.

dialogue.text: In this performance, Guangdings Hai is responsible for organising the village fishermen.
dialogue.zh: 在這場演出中，廣定海負責組織村裡的漁夫。
dialogue.ja: この公演で、広定海は村の漁師たちの組織を担当しています。
dialogue.local: In this performance, Guangdings Hai is responsible for organising the village fishermen.
dialogue.en: In this performance, Guangdings Hai is responsible for organising the village fishermen.

dialogue.text: There's no better stage than the moonlit Li Zhang River.
dialogue.zh: 沒有比月光下的漓江更好的舞台了。
dialogue.ja: 月明かりの漓江より良い舞台はありません。
dialogue.local: There's no better stage than the moonlit Li Zhang River.
dialogue.en: There's no better stage than the moonlit Li Zhang River.

dialogue.text: Performance preparations are running smoothly.
dialogue.zh: 演出準備進展順利。
dialogue.ja: 公演の準備は順調に進んでいます。
dialogue.local: Performance preparations are running smoothly.
dialogue.en: Performance preparations are running smoothly.

dialogue.text: Guangdings Hai is managing backstage.
dialogue.zh: 廣定海在後台管理。
dialogue.ja: 広定海は舞台裏を管理しています。
dialogue.local: Guangdings Hai is managing backstage.
dialogue.en: Guangdings Hai is managing backstage.

dialogue.text: His nine cormorants, the unmissable lead actors of every performance, have taken already their positions under the audience gaze.
dialogue.zh: 他的九隻鸕鶿是每場演出的主角，已經在觀眾注視下就位。
dialogue.ja: 彼の9羽のウミウは、どの公演でも欠かせない主役で、すでに観客の視線の下で位置についています。
dialogue.local: His nine cormorants, the unmissable lead actors of every performance, have taken already their positions under the audience gaze.
dialogue.en: His nine cormorants, the unmissable lead actors of every performance, have taken already their positions under the audience gaze.

dialogue.text: For cormorants, performing is clearly much easier than fishing in terms of making a living.
dialogue.zh: 對鸕鶿來說，表演顯然比捕魚更容易謀生。
dialogue.ja: ウミウにとって、公演は生計を立てる上で漁よりも明らかに簡単です。
dialogue.local: For cormorants, performing is clearly much easier than fishing in terms of making a living.
dialogue.en: For cormorants, performing is clearly much easier than fishing in terms of making a living.

dialogue.text: The thousands of years, lush mountains and rivers reside here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有千年來的青山綠水。
dialogue.ja: ここには何千年もの豊かな山と川があります。
dialogue.local: The thousands of years, lush mountains and rivers reside here.
dialogue.en: The thousands of years, lush mountains and rivers reside here.

dialogue.text: The women sing the most beautiful boat songs, whilst the men catch the most delicious river fish.
dialogue.zh: 婦女唱著最美的船歌，男人捕捉最鮮美的河魚。
dialogue.ja: 女性は最も美しい舟歌を歌い、男性は最も美味しい川魚を捕まえます。
dialogue.local: The women sing the most beautiful boat songs, whilst the men catch the most delicious river fish.
dialogue.en: The women sing the most beautiful boat songs, whilst the men catch the most delicious river fish.

dialogue.text: The cycles of time have turned and life seems as if unchanged.
dialogue.zh: 時間的輪迴轉動，生活似乎未曾改變。
dialogue.ja: 時の巡りは続き、生活は変わらないように見えます。
dialogue.local: The cycles of time have turned and life seems as if unchanged.
dialogue.en: The cycles of time have turned and life seems as if unchanged.

dialogue.text: Many people miss the old Li Zhang lifestyle.
dialogue.zh: 許多人懷念舊時的漓江生活方式。
dialogue.ja: 多くの人が昔の漓江の生活様式を懐かしんでいます。
dialogue.local: Many people miss the old Li Zhang lifestyle.
dialogue.en: Many people miss the old Li Zhang lifestyle.

dialogue.text: That was a simpler world when money was not so important.
dialogue.zh: 那是一個金錢不那麼重要的簡單世界。
dialogue.ja: お金がそれほど重要でなかった、より単純な世界でした。
dialogue.local: That was a simpler world when money was not so important.
dialogue.en: That was a simpler world when money was not so important.

dialogue.text: Yet we must recognise that times are changing.
dialogue.zh: 然而我們必須承認時代在變遷。
dialogue.ja: しかし、時代が変わっていることを認識しなければなりません。
dialogue.local: Yet we must recognise that times are changing.
dialogue.en: Yet we must recognise that times are changing.

dialogue.text: Some traditions are inevitably fading away, whilst others under our persistent efforts endeavor to remain in their original performance.
dialogue.zh: 一些傳統不可避免地逐漸消失，而另一些則在我們持續努力下力求保持原貌。
dialogue.ja: いくつかの伝統は避けられず消えつつありますが、他のものは私たちの不断の努力で元の形を保とうとしています。
dialogue.local: Some traditions are inevitably fading away, whilst others under our persistent efforts endeavor to remain in their original performance.
dialogue.en: Some traditions are inevitably fading away, whilst others under our persistent efforts endeavor to remain in their original performance.

dialogue.text: The White Dew solar term is about to pass.
dialogue.zh: 白露節氣即將結束。
dialogue.ja: 白露の節気がもうすぐ過ぎようとしています。
dialogue.local: The White Dew solar term is about to pass.
dialogue.en: The White Dew solar term is about to pass.

dialogue.text: The Ghost Festival ceremonies are also coming to an end.
dialogue.zh: 中元節的儀式也即將結束。
dialogue.ja: お盆の儀式も終わりに近づいています。
dialogue.local: The Ghost Festival ceremonies are also coming to an end.
dialogue.en: The Ghost Festival ceremonies are also coming to an end.

dialogue.text: During this period, the Chinese people look back from times past and send their most prosperous wishes for the days to come.
dialogue.zh: 在這段期間，中國人回顧過去，並送上對未來日子的美好祝福。
dialogue.ja: この期間、中国の人々は過去を振り返り、これからの日々の繁栄を願います。
dialogue.local: During this period, the Chinese people look back from times past and send their most prosperous wishes for the days to come.
dialogue.en: During this period, the Chinese people look back from times past and send their most prosperous wishes for the days to come.
